content.title: Why Did 572 People Become Ansar?
content.subtitle: A Meaningful Decision Amid Everyday Expenses
content.body:
Over the past month, Muslims Day’s Quran-related features have been used for more than 65,000 hours.

Think about that. Thousands of people are spending a part of their time with the Quran. And behind the effort to make this opportunity accessible to even more people every day are our Ansar members. They are contributing to the mission of helping more people become better Muslims.

You are not just using Muslims Day; you are helping create opportunities for others to become better too.

Alhamdulillah, 572 brothers and sisters have already joined this mission as Ansar. Our goal is 2,000 Ansar, which means 1,428 more people are still needed to join us on this journey.

What You Get as an Ansar

  • 🤝 An opportunity to be part of an ongoing Islamic service through Muslims Day

  • 💎 7 premium subscriptions to Muslims Day

  • 🎓 Special Halaqahs, seminars, and exclusive events

A special webinar on Ruqyah is coming up on August 21, and more such events are planned for Ansar, In Sha Allah.

We believe that a person can not only become better themselves but also become a means for many others to become better.

The goal of Muslims Day is to help 10 million Muslims become better than yesterday, every day.

Alhamdulillah, 572 people are already with us on this journey.

Will you be part of this service too?

👉 Join as an Ansar: https://id.kahf.co/ansar/muslimsday
